items.t: Equity positioning suffered one of its sharpest weekly drops on record: DB
items.sum: Investing.com - Global equity positioning has plummeted to a massive underweight, registering one of the sharpest weekly declines on record as forced unwinding hammered the technology sector, according to a new research report from Deutsche Bank.

items.t: Deutsche Bank Bets on Digital Asset Custody: A New Growth Catalyst?
items.sum: DB launches BaFin-approved digital asset custody services, unlocking fee income and cross-selling opportunities.

items.t: Deutsche Bank Launched Crypto Custody With Bitcoin and Ethereum but Not XRP or Solana. Why Were They Left Out?
items.sum: Germany's largest bank just opened its vault to institutional clients, and two of crypto's biggest names never got a key. The real reason may lie in who is on the guest list, and who owns one of the five spots.

items.t: Zilch Expands Debt Facilities to £395 Million
items.sum: LONDON, November 12, 2026--Zilch, the consumer payments app, today announces the successful expansion of its securitisation and corporate debt facilities by an additional £165 million in aggregate. This takes the total commitment available to £395 million, supporting high demand for its evolving product suite.
